title: Design System: Ocean’s Scenepacks — AuroraGrab Night

headline.purpose: Light 48px archive collection names, with 42/36px responsive sizes.

title.purpose: 30px shelf and season headings, 28px on phones.

collection-aside.purpose: All cutscenes chooser heading, 25px desktop and 22px phone.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: App-source underline, layout, dialog and image feedback.

motion.name: passage-out
motion.purpose: Chosen photo expands to the viewport and holds until document replacement.

motion.name: passage-out-ease
motion.purpose: Departing photographic frame.

motion.name: passage-in
motion.purpose: Transferred frame settles into the actual portrait or home photograph.

motion.name: passage-in-ease
motion.purpose: Arriving photographic frame.

motion.name: photo-transfer-window
motion.purpose: One-use cross-document photo record expiration.

motion.name: image-feedback
motion.purpose: Home photo filter and 4px arrow movement.

motion.name: arrow-color
motion.purpose: Home arrow color feedback.

motion.name: archive-image-feedback
motion.purpose: Archive image brightness feedback; no cover scale or lift.

motion.name: control-color
motion.purpose: Action color, background and border confirmation.

motion.name: control-transform
motion.purpose: Small action and control physical feedback.

motion.name: control-icon
motion.purpose: Action and back-link icon feedback.

motion.name: active-press
motion.purpose: Active .97 control press when motion is enabled.

motion.name: filter-layout
motion.purpose: Interruptible repositioning after semantic filter changes.

motion.name: filter-reveal
motion.purpose: Newly visible articles; no initial page stagger.

motion.name: filter-offset
motion.purpose: At most five delayed reveal offsets.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Native modal entry.

motion.name: dialog-out
motion.purpose: Interruptible modal dismissal.

motion.name: scene-feedback
motion.purpose: Changed preview heading and screen feedback.

motion.name: backdrop-in
motion.purpose: Native modal backdrop appearance.

motion.name: backdrop-out
motion.purpose: Native modal backdrop dismissal.

motion.name: reduced-confirmation
motion.purpose: Brief colors with manual/reduced physical motion disabled.

motion.name: sky-pulse
motion.purpose: Actual source-inspired shader light wave.

motion.name: sky-transfer-window
motion.purpose: One-use actual shader time, energy and pulse record expiration.

narrative.overview: The pinned AuroraGrab 3.0 reference supplies the real northern sky, Night palette, light Segoe headings and quiet controls.
